questions.answer: Nōn mihi, nisi admonitō, vēnisset in mentem.

questions.prompt: What harm will the mangling by wild beasts do me if I don't feel anything?
questions.answer: Quid igitur mihi ferārum laniātus oberit nihil sentientī.

questions.prompt: How much better would it have been if the promise had not been kept!
questions.answer: Quantō melius fuerat prōmissum nōn esse servātum!

questions.prompt: But it would be more equitable if Triarius passed judgment on our dispute.
questions.answer: Sed erat aequius Triārium aliquid dē dissēnsiōne nostrā iūdicāre.

questions.prompt: I wish I had been he would not now be troubling us.
questions.answer: Utinam quidem fuissem! Molestus nōbīs nōn esset.

questions.prompt: For ask Aristo, he would deny.
questions.answer: Rogēs enim Aristōnem, neget.

questions.prompt: Old men keep their mental powers, only let them keep their zeal and diligence.
questions.answer: Manent ingenia senibus, modo permaneat studium et industria.

questions.answer: Tolle hanc opīniōnem, lūctum sustuleris.

questions.answer: Ut enim ratiōnem Platō nūllam adferret, ipsā auctōritāte mē frangeret.

questions.prompt: Sextilius might have denied with impunity; for who would prove him wrong.
questions.answer: Poterat Sextilius impūne negāre: quis enim redargueret?

questions.answer: Nam nōs decēbat domum lūgēre ubi esset aliquis in lūcem ēditus.

questions.answer: Illud erat aptius, aequum cuique concēdere.

questions.answer: Similiter facis ac sī mē rogēs.

questions.answer: Crūdēlitātem horrērent velut sī cōram adesset.

questions.answer: Magis ā mē abesse vidēbāre quam sī domī essēs.

questions.answer: Aequē ā tē petō ac sī mea negōtia essent.

questions.prompt: For I enjoy myself most in that place, whether I am thinking by myself, or am either writing or reading.
questions.answer: Nam illō locō libentissimē soleō ūtī, sīve quid mēcum ipse cōgitō, sīve quid scrībō aut legō.

questions.answer: Etsī nihil aliud abstulissētis, tamen contentōs vōs esse oportēbat.

questions.answer: Etiam sī quod scrībās nōn habēbis, scrībitō tamen.

questions.answer: Id faciat saepe, dum nē lassus fīat.
